title: Workspace-Aware Naming
scenario: Use terraform.workspace to build environment-specific names from one configuration.
constraints: Use it in a resource name or tag.

focus.title: Complete the workspace-aware locals block
focus.todo: Derive the bucket name from terraform.workspace and reuse it on the bucket.

hints.why: State is Terraform's record of what it manages. A remote, locked and encrypted backend protects that record when more than one person or automation runs Terraform.
hints.what: Complete the marked TODO in `main.tf`. Derive the bucket name from terraform.workspace and reuse it on the bucket. Use the visible constraints as your checklist before you run the tests.
hints.when: Use a remote backend for any shared or production configuration. Local state is fine only for short-lived experiments.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work inside the single TODO region. Change one requirement at a time: add the named block, argument or reference, then run the tests. When a check fails, match its wording to the constraints and fix only the block it names.
